name: Nutreek
lede: A self-hosted weekly nutrition planner — plan meals, track macros, and let adaptive TDEE keep your targets honest.
about: A self-hosted weekly nutrition planner with macros, adaptive TDEE and a coach mode.
description: Nutreek is a self-hosted weekly nutrition planner: meal plans, macros per meal, day and week, offline OpenFoodFacts search, a barcode scanner, adaptive TDEE, weight and hydration tracking, and a coach mode. Installable on your phone.
summary: Plan meals, track macros, and let adaptive TDEE keep your targets honest — self-hosted, one Go binary or one container.

stack.label: Backend
stack.value: Go 1.27+ (chi, scs, goose, bcrypt, nosurf), hand-written SQL

stack.label: Database
stack.value: SQLite via modernc.org/sqlite — pure Go, no CGO

stack.label: Frontend
stack.value: html/template + HTMX + Tailwind CSS; installable as a PWA

stack.label: Deploy
stack.value: Static binary or a distroless Docker image (~20 MB), health-checked

stack.label: Your data
stack.value: One SQLite file, with optional scheduled backups and retention
